title: Joash
summary: Joash is dated in Raleigh's chronological table (1617), column Israel, by a yeere of the World. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person.
description: Added from the Raleigh import (The History of the World, 1617). Raleigh is display-only. He gives a yeere of the World, not a BC year, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: Calculated from printed figures. No tier 1–4 birth, no tier reign start, and no provisional year. Raleigh prints the yeere of the World 3165. Creation is 4032 BC (Kevin, 2026-10-28). BC = 4033 − AM, so AM 3165 = 868 BC. The figure is not written into year_bc_ad. A printed year for this person would replace it.

calculated.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 787b
calculated.arithmetic: Raleigh prints the yeere of the World 3165. Creation is 4032 BC (Kevin, 2026-10-28). BC = 4033 − AM, so AM 3165 = 868 BC. The figure is not written into year_bc_ad.

death.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 2: An Objectivist Answer to the Assyrian Synchronisms," OSF preprint v2.10 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/DT6GX, section “The Tell al-Rimah Stela”, p. 14
death.note: Death of Jehoash (Joash), king of Israel, as the paper cites Jones 2026, Chart 5.

reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 787b
reign.note: Year cell "3847 3165 172". The third printed figure 172 is the column "Temple", not a length. To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 16 at the end of the name is the reign length he prints. The end year is not printed on this row. Column: Israel..
